title: Define gf2-algebra Cargo feature-gate matrix
description:
Specify the Cargo feature-gate matrix for `gf2-algebra` — feature names, defaults, and combination compatibility — and produce the CI check matrix recommendation.

## Background

`gf2-algebra` carries multiple feature-gated paths. This issue settles the feature names, defaults, and combination compatibility rules.

Proposed feature set (input strawman, may be refined here):

- `simd` — turns on `gf2-kernels-simd` SIMD dispatch (default-on)
- `parallel` — turns on `rayon` parallel permanent (default-on)
- `hip` — turns on HIP/ROCm GPU dispatch (default-off; opt-in like `gf2-kernels-hip`)
- `f5` — compile $\mathbb{F}_5$ types and permanent (default-on once $\mathbb{F}_5$ work lands)
- `f7` — compile $\mathbb{F}_7$ types and permanent (default-on once $\mathbb{F}_7$ work lands)
- `serde` — Serde de/serialization for packed types (default-off)

Cross-feature compatibility: every combination of $\{$`simd`, `parallel`, `hip`, `f5`, `f7`, `serde`$\}$ must build cleanly.

Output: an updated `Cargo.toml` skeleton fragment in `dev/plans/d1c_feature_matrix.md` plus a CI check matrix recommendation.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `dev/plans/d1c_feature_matrix.md` exists and is attached via `jit doc add`.
- [ ] [hard] Every feature is named, defaulted, and described in one line.
- [ ] [hard] A $2^N$-cell compatibility matrix lists every feature combination, with the verification approach stated (running `cargo check` over the matrix at the crate-skeleton stage).
- [ ] [hard] The doc explicitly resolves: `simd` propagation to `gf2-kernels-simd`'s own `simd` feature; whether `hip` requires `simd`; default-on status of `f5`/`f7` once that work lands.
